test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Supercede'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word among the following is '**Supercede**'
 
• As the correct spelling would be '**Supersede**' which means take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use).
 
• Hence the correct answer to the question is '**Supercede**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 let's look at the meaning of other words,
